name: Grepafloxacin

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 5 other countries, first in 1999 — for heart harm

similar.name: Ciprofloxacin
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for nerve and brain harm and muscle and bone problems

similar.name: Temafloxacin
problems: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1992 — for blood problems and effects on the body's chemistry

similar.name: Moxifloxacin

summary: Grepafloxacin was pulled from the market in the United States and five other countries starting in 1999 because of heart harm [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, it received a high score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M]. Similar medicines have caused nerve, brain, muscle, bone, and heart harms, as well as blood and body chemistry issues that led to boxed warnings or removals from the market [4][5][6].
